title: Construction Right of Way/Status Inquiry
description: Use this service request to inquire about the status of ongoing construction or to report concerns about ongoing construction in the public right of way (i.e. street, alley or sidewalk) by private contractors or by the City of Dallas. Construction should be actively in progress. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 7 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about active construction in a public right of way.
actions.why: Ask about the status of ongoing construction or report concerns about active work in a public street, alley, or sidewalk by the City, a utility company, or a private contractor. The 311 request form asks whether the person wants status or to report a concern, where work is occurring, what kind of work is underway, the project location, and who is performing it.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Construction Right of Way/Status Inquiry"
